title: Open Decisions Finalize + Wave 3 Impact Re-run + Tuning

dependencies.reason: Wave 4 benchmark (wave_4_results.json) must exist and USER REVIEW ④ must be approved before Session 23 tuning begins

critical_notes: USER REVIEW ④ gate: do NOT start Session 23 until user has reviewed wave_4_results.json and approved.

Open Decisions to lock: (1) Orchestration — file-based handoff vs direct CLI? (plan = file-based). (2) Claude Code verify depth — top-3 or top-5? (TBD per IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:190). (3) Agent prompts — reuse phase2 or write new? (TBD per IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:191). Document locked decisions in change_manifest_session_23.json.

Wave 3 impact re-run: re-run benchmark after verifying all Wave 3 changes (IR-02 call-chain, A-01 coverage_gaps) are in place. Check if backwpup results improve (new entry points discoverable via call-chain). Compare to wave_3_results.json.

Tuning: review discovered_issues from sessions 20-22 (DI-22-01: G-05 gate deployed in session 19 — verify phase3_gate.py actually validates store_entry_point_id; DI-22-02: benchmark coverage limited to 3 plugins). Fix SKILL SET issues found during benchmark if any.
G-05 sanity check: Session 19 completed G-05 (change_manifest_session_19.json status=COMPLETED). Verify phase3_gate.py correctly handles store_entry_point_id before tuning Agent B SKILL SET.
Do not modify SKILL SETs speculatively — only tune based on concrete evidence from benchmark results or user feedback.
E1 applies: source_ref wins over session card spec if conflict detected.

files_to_read.reason: Review Wave 4 benchmark results and open_limitations before deciding tuning priorities
Open Decisions table — which decisions remain TBD and need locking in Session 23

OPEN-DECISIONS.change: Lock remaining open decisions: (3) Claude Code verify depth top-3 vs top-5, (4) Agent prompts reuse vs new. Document locked decisions + rationale. Update IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Open Decisions table.
OPEN-DECISIONS.note: If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins.

WAVE3-IMPACT-RERUN.change: Re-run benchmark/compare.py --all after confirming IR-02 (call-chain depth=2) and A-01 (coverage_gaps) are active in current IR files. If backwpup IR now discovers new entry points via call-chain, re-run phase2+phase3 for backwpup and check if TP count improves. Document delta vs wave_4_results.json.
WAVE3-IMPACT-RERUN.note: This is optional if IR files have not changed since wave_3_results.json — in that case document why re-run produces identical results.

SKILL-SET-TUNING.change: Review SKILL SET files for any issues discovered during Wave 4 benchmark. Fix only concrete issues with evidence. Do not tune speculatively. If no issues found, document this explicitly.
SKILL-SET-TUNING.note: Tuning scope limited to issues in discovered_issues[] or user feedback from USER REVIEW ④.
